Title: Product Manager Software Portfolio
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Product Manager in our Software Portfolio Organization and have ownership of a defined area within the ELERA Commerce Suite, our flagship software offering.
You will be reporting to a Sr Manager | ELERA Portfolio Owner and work closely with other Product Managers to bring our ELERA solutions to several of the Top 10 Largest Global Retailers and to the greater retail market beyond.
You will own the business justifications and market positioning for one-to-many offerings within the ELERA Portfolio — capabilities designed once and delivered to many retailers.
That translates to finding the patterns across what individual customers ask for, deciding which needs are common enough to belong in our product, and making the case for the investment behind them.
You will own the WHAT and the WHY behind our product strategy.
The WHAT is the product itself: the capabilities that belong in ELERA, the roadmap that carries them forward, and the priorities that decide what gets built first.
The WHY is the reasoning that earns them — the customer problem being solved, the market opportunity, the competitive position, and the value created for retailers and for Toshiba.
You will carry both to customers, sales, and to our executive team, and you will be the person who can articulate and defend the position and negotiate where necessary.
You will also bring that thinking to life and to tangible deliverables.
Every product direction you set is expressed in two things, authored by you, and accelerated through AI: 1) a clearly written business requirements document, and 2) a working clickable prototype to demonstrate your direction to our engineering team and to your stakeholders.
# Responsibilities
- Engage retailers, sales, partners, and market research directly to understand the business problems behind what customers ask for — and frame those problems rather than simply receive them.
- Generalize across customers. Identify the patterns that make a capability worth building once and delivering to many and distinguish those from work that is specific to a single retailer.
- Own the business justification for your offerings — opportunity, value, competitive position, and sizing — and present and defend it through portfolio prioritization.
- Define market positioning and value propositions for your offerings, and partner with marketing, sales, and services to carry them to market.
- Own and maintain the roadmap and backlog for your offerings, including the prioritization decisions and the tradeoffs behind them.
- Author the Business Requirements Document for each product direction you set, covering the WHAT and the WHY, customer and market insights and transcripts, relevant background, assumptions and exclusions, user story breakdown, and acceptance criteria.
- Create a working clickable prototype for each product direction, directing AI design and development tooling against our codebase so that engineering and stakeholders can see your intent rather than infer it from a document.
- Partner with engineering through the build, clarifying intent as questions arise and confirming that what gets delivered reflects the business case you made.
- Lead user acceptance testing and final business acceptance as the engineering cycle closes, validating that the delivered capability meets its requirements and is ready for release to market.
- Continuously sharpen how we work. The AI methods that take us from insight to prototype are evolving quickly, and we expect our Product Managers to help push that forward.
# Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of experience, or equivalent combination.
- Demonstrated ownership of a product, product area, or major business problem, with accountability for business outcomes rather than for defining or delivering a feature list
- A track record of defining product direction from customer and market evidence, including examples where you decided what not to build
- Substantial written work product — requirements, business cases, or product strategy documents you personally authored
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and with senior internal stakeholders, including the ability to hold a position under pressure and negotiate to a decision
- Hands-on use of AI tooling to produce real work products, with specific examples of what you made and how. Articulate specific examples of product requirements and UX prototyping through the use of AI.
- Evidence that you teach yourself new capability on your own initiative. This matters more to us than any particular tool on your resume because the tooling will change again.
- 8+ years in product management and demonstrated product ownership and accountability
# Preferred
- Point-of-sale, retail technology, or enterprise commerce domain experience
- Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools and clear articulation of governance and quality standards around its use
- Experience creating or directing clickable prototypes as part of a product definition process
- Experience operating within a defined portfolio governance model — prioritization rubrics, capacity tradeoffs, and formal change control
- Experience managing a portfolio of offerings where prioritization and resource allocation must be defended

> # Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
> Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI.
> Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.

# The Identity Governance and Access Security Team
The Identity Governance and Access Security team runs Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) for Okta itself — serving as Okta's "Customer Zero." The team owns the complete identity lifecycle for the workforce, from birthright provisioning through Workday to access certifications, privileged access management, and mover/leaver processes.
What the team builds becomes the reference architecture that Okta customers deploy at scale.
# The Staff Identity Security Engineer Opportunity
We're looking for a Staff Identity Security Engineer to take deep technical ownership of our Okta Identity Governance (OIG), Okta Privileged Access (OPA), and ISPM implementations.
This is a senior individual-contributor role where you'll set technical direction for how the team builds on top of these platforms and raise the bar for the engineering team through review, mentorship, and documentation.
You should be equally comfortable in an architecture discussion, in a live Okta Workflows debugging session, and writing the design doc that a Jira epic gets broken down from.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment and actively drives "what's next" for our identity security posture — identifying process bottlenecks, designing technical solutions, and pushing initiatives from concept to production without waiting for direction.
# What you'll be doing
- OIG Architecture Ownership: Own OIG architecture end-to-end — design access request workflows, entitlement/Resource Collections structures, and certification campaigns that reduce reviewer fatigue and rubber-stamping.
- Lifecycle, Birthright & RBAC Strategy: Lead lifecycle, birthright, and RBAC strategy — design and deploy automated birthright access rules, RBAC frameworks, and seamless joiner/mover/leaver (JML) processes across the enterprise.
- Workday Integration Architecture: Drive Workday integration architecture — balance scheduled reconciliation (attribute accuracy) with Real-Time Sync (immediate termination), and define the attribute sets that access rules depend on.
- Mover/Leaver Automation: Design and harden mover/leaver automation — implement attribute-driven group re-evaluation on role changes, safe decommissioning of stale access, and close gaps between automated joiner flows and historically manual processes.
- OPA, ISPM & Zero Standing Privilege: Lead OPA, ISPM, and Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) initiatives — design privileged session access, Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation, break-glass emergency access, identity security vulnerability detection, and tiering models for Tier 0/Tier 1 systems.
- PAM & ISPM Metrics: Own PAM and ISPM telemetry and KPIs — establish and track metrics around standing-privilege reduction, JIT adoption, stale access cleanup, and break-glass test success as ongoing operational measures.
- Okta Workflows Automation: Build and maintain Okta Workflows automation — streamline access requests, approvals, and remediation across IGA and PAM processes using the Okta Workflows engine.
- Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor engineers, review designs, and communicate with leadership — be the technical escalation point for the team's hardest problems, help junior engineers grow, and present clear updates, risk assessments, and roadmaps to executive stakeholders.
# What you'll bring to the role
- Domain Experience: Minimum 4+ years of direct, advanced experience managing and administering enterprise IGA, PAM/ISPM tools and platforms.
- Birthright Provisioning & RBAC: Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and deploying Birthright Provisioning models and RBAC architectures in production environments.
- PAM/OPA Tooling: Production experience with OPA or equivalent PAM tooling, including Zero Standing Privilege, Just-In-Time access models, break-glass design, and admin tiering.
- ISPM Tooling: Production experience with ISPM tools (such as Okta ISPM) that integrate with EDR solutions like Crowdstrike Falcon.
- Identity Standards: Solid grounding in identity and access standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM) and role/attribute-based access control concepts.
- Lifecycle Ownership: Track record of owning technical designs for identity lifecycle problems (joiner/mover/leaver) end-to-end, from design doc through production rollout.
- Compliance Experience: Experience operating in SOX and compliance-critical environments — understanding audit evidence requirements, segregation of duties, and access certification integrity.
- Autonomy & Executive Communication: Works independently and drives initiatives without waiting for direction, with the executive-ready communication skills to present updates, risks, and roadmaps to leadership.
# And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!
- Experience governing non-human identities (service accounts, API tokens, secrets, AI agents/workload identities) and scaling access certification programs — including distinct ownership models, lifecycle states, and certification approaches
- Familiarity with ServiceNow and JIRA-based service request intake for IGA/PAM/ISPM operations
- Okta certifications — Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, or Okta Workflows Specialist
- Technical integration experience with REST APIs, JSON parsing, webhooks, and Workday-to-IdP patterns (real-time event delivery vs. scheduled reconciliation tradeoffs)
- Experience supporting compliance audits across multiple frameworks beyond SOX (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR)
# Additional requirements
- U.S. soil status the employee must be on U.S. soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101, and be a U.S. person.
- U.S. person status the employee must be either a U.S. citizen as defined in 42 U.S. Code § 9102; a natural person who is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3); or a U.S. national (i.e. includes citizens and non-citizens born in outlying possessions such as American Samoa and Swains Island), green card holders, refugees, and asylees. Working on a U.S. visa does NOT qualify as a U.S. person.

# About Backblaze
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators.
Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.
Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.
But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us.
We’re seeking a B2 Principal Product Manager to join our team!
# About the Role
We are seeking an ambitious and accomplished Principal Product Manager to join our Product team.
Backblaze’s B2 cloud object storage offers multi-exabyte, S3-compatible, globally available object storage that unlocks app builder innovation across AI neoclouds and traditional hyperscalers at a fraction of the cost of traditional cloud infrastructure hyperscalers.
The Principal Product Manager for B2 will work closely with key stakeholders to understand the evolution of cloud storage and the customer problems in the space, and determine product strategies and roadmap to address those problems.
This person will work independently to lead efforts for new feature discovery and delivery, as well as improvements to execute on those strategies.
Understanding customer problems through interviews and market research, and translating them into requirements, is critical.
# What You'll Do
- Drive B2 product strategy and roadmap development through delivery execution.
- Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle from discovery through delivery in feature development.
- Gather and synthesize inputs for discovery and prioritization from internal functions, customers, and partners across the full spectrum of R&D development, including feature capabilities, user experience challenges, cost optimization, and technical debt.
- Translate complex customer challenges into clear, concise, and actionable product requirements in collaboration with Design, Engineering, and GTM teams.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing to launch and drive adoption of new products and features.
- Act as a subject matter expert and evangelist for Backblaze's solutions, presenting to customers, prospects, partners, and internal teams.
- Establish and track key product metrics (KPIs), using data to guide iteration and growth decisions.
- Maintain a deep understanding of the latest advancements in the object storage market, including customer use cases and competitive offerings, to identify new opportunities and ensure Backblaze’s market leadership position.
# The Right Fit
- 8+ years of Product Management experience in tech businesses, preferably on IaaS and/or SaaS offerings.
- A proven track record of successfully launching and scaling technical products or platforms in high-growth businesses involving in-depth cross-functional collaboration and leadership across R&D and go-to-market functions.
- Strong grasp of cloud architecture, APIs, and security and compliance.
- Proven success in owning product roadmaps, defining MVPs, and driving the complete product life cycle.
- Strategic thinker who can translate market trends, customer needs, and technical innovations into a clear product vision and actionable roadmap.
- Deep empathy for customers and users in gathering and synthesizing input, and a passion for solving their most pressing security challenges.
- Outstanding communication and leadership skills with a collaborative and team-oriented approach to identifying problems, determining potential solutions, and building consensus around your vision with internal and external stakeholders.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience applying data and metrics to inform product decisions and measure success.
# Bonus Points For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- MBA degree.

# Your Impact
You will lead a team of Mission Engineers who serve as Axon’s embedded builders and operational partners inside strategic public safety agencies.
Mission Engineers work face-to-face with the people doing the work, diagnose how the agency operates, and build the workflows, automations, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions that measurably improve it.
As Senior Manager, you will create the environment in which that work succeeds.
You will coach experienced individual contributors, set a clear bar for technical delivery and agency partnership, and help the team turn ambiguous field problems into secure, maintainable solutions that reach production and earn sustained adoption.
You will stay close enough to the portfolio to recognize patterns, anticipate risk, and connect what the team learns in the field back to Product, Engineering, and the broader organization.
Success is reflected in agencies becoming more capable, Mission Engineers growing into trusted transformation leaders, and strong field solutions becoming reusable patterns that benefit customers beyond a single engagement.
Axon’s mission is to Protect Life, and this team is one of the most direct ways we advance that mission alongside the agencies we serve.
# What You’ll Do
Location: Southeast US Regionally based with Travel up to 40%
Reports to: Senior Director, Customer Deployment & Mission Engineering
Direct Reports: Individual Contributors
# Lead, Coach, and Develop Mission Engineers
- Lead and develop a distributed team of embedded Mission Engineers working across strategic agency environments
- Coach individual contributors through complex technical decisions, ambiguous customer problems, executive conversations, and high-stakes delivery moments
- Establish clear expectations for ownership, technical quality, onsite partnership, production delivery, adoption, documentation, and measurable agency impact

- Guide the team from discovery through production use, iteration, handoff, and sustained adoption
- Help Mission Engineers balance immediate agency needs with secure, maintainable, and scalable solution design
- Reinforce that success means the agency is more capable—not that one individual has become indispensable
# Own a Strategic Mission Engineering Portfolio
- Maintain visibility across strategic agencies, active builds, adoption progress, technical risk, and emerging operational needs
- Match Mission Engineer capability and level to agency complexity, transformation opportunity, and stakeholder environment
- Use operating reviews and portfolio data to identify delivery risks, recurring friction, adoption barriers, and opportunities for reuse
- Step into critical situations with structure and calm while coaching the accountable Mission Engineer to remain in ownership
- Drive consistent execution across embedded engagements without forcing every agency problem into the same playbook

- Translate complex technical and operational issues into decisions that are clear to both technical teams and executive audiences

# What You Bring
# Required

- 5+ years leading and developing senior technical individual contributors in customer-facing organizations
- Demonstrated success coaching teams that deliver secure, production-ready solutions in complex customer environments

# Location: Hong Kong, fully in-office (no remote work)
# Dates: 10 weeks, May - August start date - dependent on your course.
Join Marshall Wace for the summer and experience first-hand what it means to be a member of the highly innovative and fast-paced technology team that powers one of the world's largest hedge funds.
Interns in this programme will be given projects that both provide real-world engineering experience and drive our business forward.
Technology touches every aspect of MW, and interns will have the opportunity to build systems that enable success in domains throughout the business.
These domains include our systematic and fundamental investment strategies, firmwide technology platform, trading and order execution, AI-powered automation and enhancements of workflows, and many others.
Prior to the start of the internship, our various tech teams will propose potential projects for interns.
We select the projects that are the most valuable to the firm and that stand to provide the most engaging and valuable experience.
Interns are then assigned to selected projects in pairs, reporting to a senior engineer.
Throughout the internship, interns receive comprehensive support from our teams.
In addition to direct mentorship by their managers, this support includes regular seminars on the many segments of the MW tech estate, informational sessions on other areas of the business with senior leaders, social events, and opportunities to engage in the firm’s charitable activities.
All of this is in service of our goal to provide our interns with extensive professional and technical development and a broad understanding of our business and of the finance industry at large.
# Examples of past projects
- A backtesting framework for our quantitative trading system
- Horizontally distributed autonomous coding agents
- AI-driven user behaviour analytics platform
# What are we looking for?
This internship is ideal for an innovative problem solver who can demonstrate inventive and creative use of technology.
